termsDesc: The same terms you agree to when you create an Adrenaline account.

questionsLine: Message the team and we'll get back to you within 24 hours.
privacyBodyHtml:
Adrenaline is a youth trips & experiences brand in Egypt. This policy explains what personal information we collect when you use adrenaline98.com, why we need it, and the choices you have. We collect only what we need to run your trips safely.

1. What we collect.

  • Your account: name, email address, password (stored only as an encrypted hash, never in plain text), phone number, nationality, date of birth and, if you add one, a profile photo.
  • Google sign-in: if you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email address and profile photo from Google. We never see your Google password.
  • Bookings: for each traveller on a booking we collect their name, phone number, gender, national ID or passport number and a photo of it, an emergency contact name and phone number, and any medical condition you tell us about. We also keep your payment method (InstaPay or Vodafone Cash), payment screenshots, promo codes and special requests.
  • Other things you send us: custom trip requests, messages from the Contact page and reviews you write.

2. Why we use it. To create and secure your account; to confirm your bookings, verify your payments and hold your seats; to prepare traveller lists for the trip team; to keep you safe on the trip (that's why we ask for ID, an emergency contact and medical conditions); to answer your messages and requests; and to email you about your bookings and, if you agree, about new trips.

3. Who sees it. We never sell your data. It is only seen by:

  • The Adrenaline team and the guides and organisers running your trip. Traveller lists (name, phone number and booking ID) are kept in Adrenaline's own Google Sheets so the trip team can check everyone in.
  • Hotels, transport companies and checkpoints, only when a trip needs it (for example, names and ID numbers for hotel check-in or travel permits).
  • The services that run our website: MongoDB Atlas (database), Cloudinary (photo and screenshot storage), Brevo and Gmail (emails), Google (sign-in and traveller lists) and our hosting provider. They process data only to provide their service to us.
  • Authorities, if Egyptian law requires it.

4. Emails. We send emails you need, like login codes and booking updates. If you opt in, we also email you about new trips. You can unsubscribe at any time from the link in any trip email or from your profile.

5. Cookies. We use a small number of cookies to keep you logged in and to remember your language. Your light or dark theme choice is stored in your browser. We don't use advertising or tracking cookies.

6. How long we keep it. We keep your account information while your account is open. Booking and payment records are kept after a trip, and after you close your account, so we can handle refunds, disputes and our legal obligations. You can ask us to delete your personal data at any time; we'll delete what we aren't required to keep.

7. Your choices. You can see and update your details from your profile, change your email preferences, close your account from your profile, or ask us for a copy of your data or for it to be deleted through the Contact page.

8. Security. Passwords are hashed, the site runs over HTTPS, and only authorised team members can open booking details. No system is perfectly secure, so please keep your password private and tell us straight away if you think your account has been accessed.

9. Age. You must be at least 18 years old to create an account and book a trip. If you book for someone else, including a younger traveller, make sure you have their permission (or their parent's or guardian's) to share their details with us.

10. Changes. We may update this policy as the website changes. We'll change the date at the top, and for important changes we'll let you know by email or on the site.

11. Contact. Questions about your data? Reach us through the Contact page or linktr.ee/Adrenaline98.
